title: Ephemeral hedge-window and rogue-connection stall mitigation
author: Elena Park
release_notes: Introduce a short-lived hedge window to prevent rapid cross-region reopen oscillations and a defensive fix for long-lived 'stalled' connections. This reduces SLO breach spikes during region failover and improves stability under transient control-plane lag.
description: Context and motivation: We observed several production incidents where region failovers combined with delayed connection teardown led to long-lived 'rogue' connections occupying slots and preventing graceful failover. Those stalls caused the SLO enforcer to overreact (aggressive shed) and then oscillate as retries reopened capacity, creating a short surge of errors and amplified latency. This PR introduces an ephemeral 'hedge window' that temporarily holds reopen attempts for a small cohort while a lightweight probe verifies node readiness, and a defensive connection fence mechanism that force-closes connections flagged as stalled by age+no-progress heuristics. Design summary: 1) Hedge window coordinator: a new in-memory coordinator (per-allocator) that tracks a small ephemeral cohort of tenants entering reopen flow after a regional failover. The coordinator delays reopen admission by a configurable window (default 1s) and subjects candidates to a fast readiness probe (health + KV-drain progress). This reduces simultaneous reopen storms. 2) Rogue connection stall detector: add lightweight progress counters to connection objects and a periodic scavenger that identifies connections with no forward progress for N seconds (configurable, default 30s). When detected, the fence actively terminates the connection and increments a telemetry counter. 3) SLO enforcer smoothing: tie the hedge admission events to the SLO enforcer so that ephemeral hedged cohorts are treated with relaxed immediate penalties (short-term grace) to avoid over-shedding. 4) Rollout plan: feature gated behind runtime flag (hedge.window.enabled + conn.fence.enabled) and default-off for Dedicated customers; staged rollout to hosted API first in a single region, validate telemetry, then enable global by percentage. Checklist and testing performed: - Unit tests for coordinator state transitions and race windows. - Integration test that simulates region failover with 500 tenants and verifies reopen storm suppression. - End-to-end chaos test where probe responses are artificially delayed; verifies SLO enforcer does not oscillate. - Safety nets: metric exposes hedges_in_flight, connections_terminated_by_fence, and hedged_admissions_denied. - Performance: microbenchmarks show ~0.5% overhead on normal request path; a regression benchmark included with PR and accepted by SRE. Commits summary: - 7f3a2ff: add hedge window coordinator and tests - 1b9c4e0: integrate hedging with SLO enforcer and expose metrics - a2d7f91: connection stall detector and fence implementation - 9c4e8aa: add config flags and remote rollout gating - d5b71b3: integration and chaos tests + benchmark harness - e4f0c2b: docs and runtime flags in config reference Changed areas (high-level): - services/allocator/hedge_coordinator.go: new coordinator + unit tests - runtime/slo/enforcer.go: admission smoothing hooks and metric bindings - runtime/connection/conn_fence.go: stall detector and fence logic - infra/telemetry/metrics.yaml: new metrics and dashboards entries - ci/integration/chaos/reopen_storm_test.go: simulated failover test - docs/operations/hedge-window.md: operator-facing rollout guide - pkg/config/flags.go: runtime flags and default values Review summary: - Initial review requested by Marco Rivera flagged a potential race at allocator shutdown; added shutdown drain path guarded by atomic and covered by added unit test. - Priya requested clearer telemetry names and a safeguard to prevent excessive forced closes; added a cooldown per-tenant to limit fence frequency. - Jinwoo ran heavy integration runs and asked for a canary rollout plan, which is included in docs. Runtime impact and mitigation: Hedge window is opt-in via flag; defaults conservative. Connection fence uses an age+no-progress heuristic with tenant-level cooldown (default 5 minutes) to avoid retry storms. Metrics and alerting: New alerts recommended: spike in connections_terminated_by_fence (P2), repeated hedged_admissions_denied over 1m (P3). Rollout: Canary in 'us-west-2' for 48h, watch hedges_in_flight and SLO error budget burn, then 10% global, then full. Merge and follow-ups: Squash-merged after CI green and Marco's approval. Follow-up ticket created (ENG-1990) to add historical sampling to hedged cohorts for offline analysis.
